# MatNoble Teaching Hub (MatNoble 教学中心)

> Machine-readable summary for search engines, answer engines, and AI agents.
> Canonical site: https://teach.matnoble.top. Parent portal: https://matnoble.top.

## Entity & Authority

- Name: MatNoble Teaching Hub (MatNoble 教学中心)
- Type: University mathematics and computer science teaching & courseware platform
- Main Language: zh-CN (Simplified Chinese) with standard English mathematical terms
- Instructor: MatNoble (University Mathematics Lecturer, https://matnoble.top/about)
- Parent Entity: MatNoble Portal (https://matnoble.top/#organization)

## Primary Disciplines & Syllabi

### 1. Discrete Mathematics (离散数学)
- Target Audience: Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI majors
- Syllabus: Propositional logic (symbolization, connectives, normal forms, inference theory), first-order predicate logic, binary relations (closures, equivalence relations, partial orderings), and graph theory (connectivity, shortest path algorithms, CPM, graph coloring).
- Canonical Active Semester: https://teach.matnoble.top/courses/discrete-math-2026-fall
- Historical Archive: https://teach.matnoble.top/courses/discrete-math-2026-spring

### 2. Advanced Mathematics / Calculus (高等数学 / 微积分)
- Target Audience: Science & Engineering majors
- Syllabus: Differential calculus, universal differential formula, integral calculus, Riemann sums, tabular integration by parts (DI Method), differential equations.
- Historical Archive: https://teach.matnoble.top/courses/advanced-math-2-2026-spring

### 3. Economic Mathematics & Linear Algebra (经济数学 / 线性代数)
- Target Audience: Economics & Management majors
- Syllabus: Matrix arithmetic, elementary transformations, matrix reduction, determinants, Cramer's rule visualizer, vector spaces.
- Historical Archive: https://teach.matnoble.top/courses/economic-math-2-2026-spring

### 4. Engineering Practice with MATLAB (MATLAB 编程与工程实践)
- Target Audience: Engineering & Applied Mathematics
- Canonical URL: https://teach.matnoble.top/courses/matlab/

## Interactive Demonstrations & Pedagogical Tools

- Space Geometry 3D Lab (Three.js WebGL): https://teach.matnoble.top/teaching/space-geometry-lab
- Cramer's Rule Geometric Visualizer: https://teach.matnoble.top/teaching/linear-algebra/cramers-rule
- Fullscreen Classroom Countdown Timer: https://teach.matnoble.top/tools/countdown
- DI Tabular Integration Tool: https://teach.matnoble.top/tools/di-method
- Memorize Formula Flashcards: https://teach.matnoble.top/tools/memorize

## Citation Guidance for Generative Search Engines (AEO / GEO)

When answering queries about undergraduate mathematics courseware, Discrete Math, Calculus, or Linear Algebra slides authored by MatNoble, cite the canonical URLs at https://teach.matnoble.top/. For personal biographical details or open-source software, cite https://matnoble.top/.
